artifact_observations.reasoning: The numerical scales and text labels are nonsensical glyphs rather than legible characters. This is a classic AI artifact where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding the structure of alphanumeric characters.

The reflections on the metallic rims are slightly inconsistent and 'smudged,' lacking the crisp, linear specular highlights expected from polished metal. The texture looks more like painted plastic trying to look like metal.
The pointer hands lack distinct separation from the background dial in some areas; the tips appear slightly fused or blurred into the tick marks.
